ViewerSession.name: awh_viewer
ViewerSession.description: Separately provisioned opaque, expiring HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/dashboard/v1 cookie. Secure for a future HTTPS gateway. No CP Client/GitHub bearer.

x-cursor-semantics.rest: ID-ascending live keyset; bound to resource, sorted viewer scope and filters. Limit 1..100. No total count or frozen multi-request Registry snapshot. Restart on invalid_cursor.
x-cursor-semantics.timeline: Global SQLite Event cursor (not Run sequence). Ascending; gaps are normal; never per-scope renumbered.
x-cursor-semantics.reconnect: Fetch REST snapshot at W. First stream after=W. On reconnect refresh snapshot then replay after the last processed event cursor C, not the refreshed W. Dedupe by global cursor; project/run filters are applied again. New sessions with narrower scope rebootstrap.
x-cursor-semantics.retention: Append-only history is retained, no compaction in v1; future cursor rejected. Copying/rebinding the database requires the separately gated host-migration work.

x-security: Default disabled. Separate trusted viewer session registry; no session issuance/admin route. Exact loopback Host/socket plus Origin/Fetch-Metadata guard; no CORS. All non-GET dashboard methods fail before body parsing. Sessions never authenticate /v1 Client routes. Expiry rechecked during streams.

x-negative-examples.request: GET /dashboard/v1/projects with Authorization: Bearer <CP Client credential>
